bias_targets.methodology: The paper relies on extracting informative key-phrases using an unsupervised embedding-based pipeline (sBERT-Rank) that utilizes dependency tree parsing and sBERT representations to identify keywords intended for downstream analysis of political bias (as indicated by the supplementary figures on Political DCG).
Evaluating document stance alignments (e.g., "Pro", "Neutral", "Against", "Not-about") by leveraging the extracted key-phrases to measure viewpoint and stance biases in texts.
